In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> a '''coastal defender stormtrooper''' processed convicts that were being [[transport]]ed off of the [[planet]] [[Niamos]].

==Biography==
This [[human]] was<ref name="Human" /> a [[Coastal defender stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] by [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[soldier]] served near a [[Niamos Courthouse|courthouse]] on [[Niamos]] along with several others.<ref name="Narkina 5" /> The [[trooper]] would process prisoners found guilty of crime, asking for their name and [[homeworld]], before sending them to an [[Imperial Prison Transport|Imperial prison transport]] bound for a [[prison]] or similar penal facility somewhere in [[Galaxy|the galaxy.]]<ref name="Narkina 5" /> One of the convicts processed was [[Tuck Hybecks]] of [[Galdi]], who the shoretrooper sent to [[Belsavis]]. The next prisoner was [[Cassian Jeron Andor]], in hiding on Niamos under the alias of a tourist named "Keef Girgo" from [[Deris-plata]]. The trooper gestured Andor to a prison transport destined for the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison complex]] on [[Narkina 5]]. When Andor asked what that meant, panicking and telling the shoretrooper that he was innocent and "just a tourist", two other shoretroopers grabbed him and pushed him onto the [[transport]], threatening him with [[Zap rod|zap rods]].<ref name="Narkina 5" /> 

==Equipment==
The shoretrooper used a set of shoretrooper [[Shoretrooper armor|armor]] with a white stripe on the chest. The soldier used a [[datapad]] to help process the prisoners.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

{{Char-stub}}
